tasks.label: commit and push
tasks.command: git add -A; git commit -m "Sudoku: make all three levels easier (47/39/33 printed numbers)"; git push origin main; echo '--- log ---'; git log --oneline -2; git status -sb

tasks.label: commit and push sudoku
tasks.command: git add -A; git commit -F .git/WB_MSG; git push origin main; echo '--- log ---'; git log --oneline -2; echo '--- status ---'; git status -sb; echo '--- remote ---'; git ls-remote --heads origin
